decks.module: Right of way and steady vehicle signals
decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Delaware’s right-of-way laws identify who must yield; yielding to prevent a crash remains ____.
cards.back: Delaware’s right-of-way laws identify who must yield; yielding to prevent a crash remains appropriate regardless of the assigned duty.
cards.memory_hook: appropriate regardless of the assigned duty

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Traffic signs and signals apply to people walking, cycling and ____.
cards.back: Traffic signs and signals apply to people walking, cycling and driving on streets or highways.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The red-light camera program photographs violators, records plate ____.
cards.back: The red-light camera program photographs violators, records plate numbers and mails citations.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook’s basic signal cue is red for stopping, yellow for preparing to ____.
cards.back: The handbook’s basic signal cue is red for stopping, yellow for preparing to stop and green for cautious progress.
cards.memory_hook: stop and green for cautious progress

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A signal arrow governs only the ____.
cards.back: A signal arrow governs only the direction it points.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At steady red, stop at the line, otherwise before the crosswalk, or ____.
cards.back: At steady red, stop at the line, otherwise before the crosswalk, or before the intersection if neither exists.
cards.memory_hook: before the intersection if neither exists

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A right turn at red requires a complete stop and is allowed only when safe and when neither a sign nor ____.
cards.back: A right turn at red requires a complete stop and is allowed only when safe and when neither a sign nor a steady red arrow forbids it.
cards.memory_hook: a steady red arrow forbids it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After a complete stop, a safe left turn on red from one one-way street into another is permitted unless a sign ____.
cards.back: After a complete stop, a safe left turn on red from one one-way street into another is permitted unless a sign or steady red arrow forbids it.
cards.memory_hook: or steady red arrow forbids it

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady yellow announces the change from green to red; prepare to stop, but cross cautiously if already ____.
cards.back: A steady yellow announces the change from green to red; prepare to stop, but cross cautiously if already too close for a safe stop.
cards.memory_hook: too close for a safe stop

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady green permits safe forward movement or a turn unless another ____.
cards.back: A steady green permits safe forward movement or a turn unless another signal or sign prohibits that turn.
cards.memory_hook: signal or sign prohibits that turn

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On green, yield to people and vehicles already in the ____.
cards.back: On green, yield to people and vehicles already in the intersection or neighboring crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When turning on green, take particular care around ____.
cards.back: When turning on green, take particular care around pedestrians and opposing traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Treat flashing red like a stop sign: stop completely and ____.
cards.back: Treat flashing red like a stop sign: stop completely and move only when safe.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Flashing yellow calls for reduced speed, heightened attention and cautious ____.
cards.back: Flashing yellow calls for reduced speed, heightened attention and cautious movement through the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When an installed signal shows no illuminated indication, reduce speed and get ready to yield to ____.
cards.back: When an installed signal shows no illuminated indication, reduce speed and get ready to yield to vehicles in or nearing the intersection.
cards.memory_hook: vehicles in or nearing the intersection

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Round signal lenses apply in every direction, while ____.
cards.back: Round signal lenses apply in every direction, while an arrow is direction-specific.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady red arrow requires a complete stop and prohibits ____.
cards.back: A steady red arrow requires a complete stop and prohibits movement in its direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A flashing red arrow allows a turn in its direction after a complete stop and ____.
cards.back: A flashing red arrow allows a turn in its direction after a complete stop and selection of a safe traffic gap.
cards.memory_hook: selection of a safe traffic gap

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady yellow arrow ends the green-arrow interval; continue carefully if ____.
cards.back: A steady yellow arrow ends the green-arrow interval; continue carefully if too close to halt safely.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A flashing yellow arrow permits the indicated movement after yielding ____.
cards.back: A flashing yellow arrow permits the indicated movement after yielding to opposing vehicles and pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady green arrow permits cautious movement in its direction, with yielding to people ____.
cards.back: A steady green arrow permits cautious movement in its direction, with yielding to people and vehicles lawfully occupying the intersection.
cards.memory_hook: and vehicles lawfully occupying the intersection

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where pedestrian and vehicle signals work together, drivers follow vehicle signals and pedestrians ____.
cards.back: Where pedestrian and vehicle signals work together, drivers follow vehicle signals and pedestrians follow WALK or DON’T WALK indications.
cards.memory_hook: follow WALK or DON’T WALK indications

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: WALK permits a pedestrian to proceed while remaining ____.
cards.back: WALK permits a pedestrian to proceed while remaining alert for turning vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian displaying ____.
cards.back: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian displaying a WALK indication.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A pedestrian already crossing when DON’T WALK begins flashing should finish ____.
cards.back: A pedestrian already crossing when DON’T WALK begins flashing should finish crossing as quickly as possible.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A pedestrian who has not begun crossing must not start ____.
cards.back: A pedestrian who has not begun crossing must not start during flashing DON’T WALK.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A steady DON’T WALK means a pedestrian must ____.
cards.back: A steady DON’T WALK means a pedestrian must not begin crossing.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Accessible pedestrian signals provide nonvisual crossing information through sounds, ____.
cards.back: Accessible pedestrian signals provide nonvisual crossing information through sounds, spoken messages or vibration.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Accessible pedestrian signals communicate when the WALK interval starts and ends to ____.
cards.back: Accessible pedestrian signals communicate when the WALK interval starts and ends to blind or visually impaired people.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Audible pedestrian signals can also guide direction at angled ____.
cards.back: Audible pedestrian signals can also guide direction at angled intersections and wide crossings.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pressing the crosswalk button activates a HAWK sequence that stops traffic for crossing ____.
cards.back: Pressing the crosswalk button activates a HAWK sequence that stops traffic for crossing and later resets after traffic resumes.
cards.memory_hook: and later resets after traffic resumes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Rectangular rapid-flashing beacons at pedestrian or bicycle crossings are activated by a ____.
cards.back: Rectangular rapid-flashing beacons at pedestrian or bicycle crossings are activated by a pedestrian’s or cyclist’s push button.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A rectangular rapid-flashing beacon uses a rapid ____.
cards.back: A rectangular rapid-flashing beacon uses a rapid stuttering flash pattern.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a rapid-flashing crossing beacon operates, slow down, check for pedestrians and ____.
cards.back: When a rapid-flashing crossing beacon operates, slow down, check for pedestrians and bicyclists, and yield when needed.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Circular or arrow signals designated by a bicycle sign govern bicyclists in ____.
cards.back: Circular or arrow signals designated by a bicycle sign govern bicyclists in the specified bicycle lanes or paths.
cards.memory_hook: the specified bicycle lanes or paths

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Bicycle-shaped signal indicators have circular-signal meanings for bicyclists in designated ____.
cards.back: Bicycle-shaped signal indicators have circular-signal meanings for bicyclists in designated bicycle lanes or paths.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists riding in general traffic lanes must follow the normal ____.
cards.back: Cyclists riding in general traffic lanes must follow the normal round and arrow signals.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A highway sign’s shape, color, wording and symbols ____.
cards.back: A highway sign’s shape, color, wording and symbols help identify its information.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Regulatory signs communicate laws about such matters as direction, lane ____.
cards.back: Regulatory signs communicate laws about such matters as direction, lane use, turns, speed and parking.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Regulatory signs are commonly white, red or black and may be ____.
cards.back: Regulatory signs are commonly white, red or black and may be rectangular, square or specially shaped.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The stop sign is the highway’s only eight-sided sign and ____.
cards.back: The stop sign is the highway’s only eight-sided sign and has white lettering on red.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a stop sign, stop fully at the line; if absent, at the crosswalk; if ____.
cards.back: At a stop sign, stop fully at the line; if absent, at the crosswalk; if both are absent, before the intersection.
cards.memory_hook: both are absent, before the intersection

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before leaving a stop sign, yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection, ____.
cards.back: Before leaving a stop sign, yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection, checking for less conspicuous road users.
cards.memory_hook: checking for less conspicuous road users

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a yield sign, give way to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection, stopping if ____.
cards.back: At a yield sign, give way to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection, stopping if needed, and proceed only when safe.
cards.memory_hook: needed, and proceed only when safe

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Approach a yield sign slowly, check both directions and yield ____.
cards.back: Approach a yield sign slowly, check both directions and yield to lawful movements and crossings.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A posted speed-limit sign establishes the limit for ____.
cards.back: A posted speed-limit sign establishes the limit for that highway segment.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: International turn-prohibition signs used in Delaware include prohibitions on left ____.
cards.back: International turn-prohibition signs used in Delaware include prohibitions on left turns, right turns and U-turns.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Obey the overhead indication for your lane; an arrow marked ONLY ____.
cards.back: Obey the overhead indication for your lane; an arrow marked ONLY requires travel in that direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Warning signs are generally yellow with black text or symbols, and ____.
cards.back: Warning signs are generally yellow with black text or symbols, and most have a diamond shape.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Warning signs call for slowing down and readiness to stop for ____.
cards.back: Warning signs call for slowing down and readiness to stop for a hazard or special condition.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A five-sided black-on-yellow sign warns only of a school or school crossing; ____.
cards.back: A five-sided black-on-yellow sign warns only of a school or school crossing; fluorescent yellow-green may also be used.
cards.memory_hook: fluorescent yellow-green may also be used

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a school-warning sign, reduce speed, watch for children ____.
cards.back: At a school-warning sign, reduce speed, watch for children and stop when necessary.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A round yellow sign with black markings warns in advance ____.
cards.back: A round yellow sign with black markings warns in advance of a highway-rail crossing.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At an advance rail-crossing warning, slow down and watch ____.
cards.back: At an advance rail-crossing warning, slow down and watch carefully, especially at night.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A sharp-right-turn warning calls for ____.
cards.back: A sharp-right-turn warning calls for reduced speed.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A winding-road warning calls for a ____.
cards.back: A winding-road warning calls for a speed adjustment.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A yield-ahead warning calls for slowing and readiness either to stop at the ____.
cards.back: A yield-ahead warning calls for slowing and readiness either to stop at the yield sign or adjust to traffic.
cards.memory_hook: yield sign or adjust to traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle warning on a shared road calls for looking ____.
cards.back: A bicycle warning on a shared road calls for looking in both directions for cyclists.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A narrowing-road warning calls ____.
cards.back: A narrowing-road warning calls for slowing.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A divided-highway-ahead warning directs drivers to ____.
cards.back: A divided-highway-ahead warning directs drivers to keep right.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a warning of unpaved or unknown road surface, slow down and check ____.
cards.back: At a warning of unpaved or unknown road surface, slow down and check vehicle control on the changed surface.
cards.memory_hook: vehicle control on the changed surface

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Where the road has room for only one traffic lane, slow down and ____.
cards.back: Where the road has room for only one traffic lane, slow down and prepare to yield to opposing vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: prepare to yield to opposing vehicles

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A warning of a potentially hazardous two-lane passage calls for reduced speed ____.
cards.back: A warning of a potentially hazardous two-lane passage calls for reduced speed and attention to opposing vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An added-lane warning means merging is unnecessary, while attention to ____.
cards.back: An added-lane warning means merging is unnecessary, while attention to vehicles changing lanes remains necessary.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For a steep hill, slow down and prepare to select a lower gear to ____.
cards.back: For a steep hill, slow down and prepare to select a lower gear to manage speed and spare the brakes.
cards.memory_hook: manage speed and spare the brakes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The slippery-when-wet caption identifies the first half-hour of rain as ____.
cards.back: The slippery-when-wet caption identifies the first half-hour of rain as the most hazardous period.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A two-way-traffic warning marks the end of one-way operation and ____.
cards.back: A two-way-traffic warning marks the end of one-way operation and reminds drivers of opposing traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bump warning calls for a speed adjustment ____.
cards.back: A bump warning calls for a speed adjustment to maintain control.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A playground warning calls for caution because many ____.
cards.back: A playground warning calls for caution because many children may be present.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A deer-crossing warning calls for watching both sides of ____.
cards.back: A deer-crossing warning calls for watching both sides of the road for deer.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a roundabout warning, reduce speed and yield to pedestrians ____.
cards.back: At a roundabout warning, reduce speed and yield to pedestrians and vehicles already circulating.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A crossroad warning calls for attention to crossing vehicles and ____.
cards.back: A crossroad warning calls for attention to crossing vehicles and any regulatory signs or signals.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An advisory-speed sign recommends a speed for its road section and is ____.
cards.back: An advisory-speed sign recommends a speed for its road section and is often mounted below another warning sign.
cards.memory_hook: often mounted below another warning sign

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A farm-machinery warning on a shared road calls for alertness ____.
cards.back: A farm-machinery warning on a shared road calls for alertness and readiness to reduce speed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A horse-drawn-vehicle warning calls for alertness and readiness ____.
cards.back: A horse-drawn-vehicle warning calls for alertness and readiness to reduce speed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In a zipper merge, drivers use both lanes up to the lane-reduction point ____.
cards.back: In a zipper merge, drivers use both lanes up to the lane-reduction point and then take alternating turns merging.
cards.memory_hook: and then take alternating turns merging

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Most guide signs are rectangular, with white ____.
cards.back: Most guide signs are rectangular, with white lettering against green.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A guide-sign arrow indicates the direction to ____.
cards.back: A guide-sign arrow indicates the direction to the named destination.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: United States route markers use black numerals on ____.
cards.back: United States route markers use black numerals on a white U.S.-shield background.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: State route markers use black lettering on ____.
cards.back: State route markers use black lettering on a white circle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An Interstate route shield has a red upper quarter with white Interstate lettering and a blue lower ____.
cards.back: An Interstate route shield has a red upper quarter with white Interstate lettering and a blue lower portion with a white route number.
cards.memory_hook: portion with a white route number

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Motorist-service signs typically use white text ____.
cards.back: Motorist-service signs typically use white text against blue rectangles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Recreation signs generally have white lettering ____.
cards.back: Recreation signs generally have white lettering against brown.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Flashing beacons can emphasize a sign or identify ____.
cards.back: Flashing beacons can emphasize a sign or identify when its message applies.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Beacons supplementing warning or speed-limit signs ____.
cards.back: Beacons supplementing warning or speed-limit signs are yellow.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Beacons supplementing Stop or Do Not Enter ____.
cards.back: Beacons supplementing Stop or Do Not Enter signs are red.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Supplementary circular beacons flash regularly, at roughly one ____.
cards.back: Supplementary circular beacons flash regularly, at roughly one flash per second.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A work zone is a highway area where construction, maintenance ____.
cards.back: A work zone is a highway area where construction, maintenance or utility activity takes place.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone control devices begin ahead of the activity ____.
cards.back: Work-zone control devices begin ahead of the activity and extend past it.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work zones may stay in one place or move ____.
cards.back: Work zones may stay in one place or move slowly along the road.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone traffic controls may include signs, arrow panels, pavement markings, ____.
cards.back: Work-zone traffic controls may include signs, arrow panels, pavement markings, cones, drums or barricades.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Warning signs in work zones are ____.
cards.back: Warning signs in work zones are usually orange.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Stay alert in work zones for altered traffic patterns and slowing or stopped vehicles that may be ____.
cards.back: Stay alert in work zones for altered traffic patterns and slowing or stopped vehicles that may be hidden by a hill or curve.
cards.memory_hook: hidden by a hill or curve

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers must follow work-zone police and ____.
cards.back: Drivers must follow work-zone police and flagger directions.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A lane-closure warning calls for preparing to leave ____.
cards.back: A lane-closure warning calls for preparing to leave the closing lane.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone speeding fines ____.
cards.back: Work-zone speeding fines are doubled.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In a work zone, avoid abrupt maneuvers and weaving, and brake gradually to ____.
cards.back: In a work zone, avoid abrupt maneuvers and weaving, and brake gradually to give following drivers time to slow.
cards.memory_hook: give following drivers time to slow

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Rough surfaces, metal plates, uneven lanes and pavement-edge drop-offs in work zones ____.
cards.back: Rough surfaces, metal plates, uneven lanes and pavement-edge drop-offs in work zones call for gradual, controlled movements.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Maintain reasonable speed and following space in a work zone so slowing or ____.
cards.back: Maintain reasonable speed and following space in a work zone so slowing or stopped traffic leaves room to respond.
cards.memory_hook: stopped traffic leaves room to respond

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone traffic may be stopped for alternating single-lane use, entering workers ____.
cards.back: Work-zone traffic may be stopped for alternating single-lane use, entering workers or machinery, or hazardous work.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Temporary signals, police or certified flaggers with stop slash slow paddles ____.
cards.back: Temporary signals, police or certified flaggers with stop slash slow paddles may control stopped work-zone traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone regulatory signs communicate speed limits and other rules, and ____.
cards.back: Work-zone regulatory signs communicate speed limits and other rules, and limits may be reduced.

decks.domain: Traffic signals, signs and work zones

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone warning signs are usually orange diamonds, with some ____.
cards.back: Work-zone warning signs are usually orange diamonds, with some rectangular signs also used.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Barricades, drums, cones and tubular markers warn of work-area hazards and ____.
cards.back: Barricades, drums, cones and tubular markers warn of work-area hazards and guide traffic through the zone.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Channelizing devices often carry steady or flashing lights ____.
cards.back: Channelizing devices often carry steady or flashing lights for nighttime visibility.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Flashing or sequencing arrow panels may guide traffic into selected lanes and warn of a ____.
cards.back: Flashing or sequencing arrow panels may guide traffic into selected lanes and warn of a road closure during day or night.
cards.memory_hook: road closure during day or night

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Work-zone flaggers stop, slow or guide traffic using red flags ____.
cards.back: Work-zone flaggers stop, slow or guide traffic using red flags or stop slash slow paddles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook describes work-zone flaggers wearing yellow-green shirts, ____.
cards.back: The handbook describes work-zone flaggers wearing yellow-green shirts, jackets or vests.
